summary: You can now complete each setup step right inside the Get Started wizard.

new.title: Get Started is a real wizard
new.text: Every Get Started step now has its own fields, with Previous, Save & exit and Save & next. A refused save stays on the step and shows the reason.

new.title: Demo mode for live demos
new.text: Off by default. Visitors in a demo group can look at everything and stage changes, but nothing is saved, and a banner says it is a demo.

fixes.title: No double removals
fixes.text: Asking to remove something that is already queued adds nothing and says "already queued".

fixes.title: Large tenants keep every snapshot
fixes.text: The current assignments snapshot is no longer lost in busy tenants with ten thousand assignments.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The setup scripts now name the Invardia Support app; the old wording still works.
